label: Bible Study
prompt: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy _____, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
verse: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
note: Asked which commandment is greatest, Jesus reached for Deuteronomy 6 — all of you, nothing held back.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But after that the _____ and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
verse: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
note: Paul tells Titus that God's kindness and love appeared in person — in our Saviour.

label: Sunday School
prompt: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's _____; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
verse: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
note: Jonah's own book says 'great fish,' but the KJV in Matthew says whale — and Jesus makes the three days a sign of his own.

label: Deep Water
prompt: With him is an _____ of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
verse: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
note: Hezekiah sizes up Assyria for his people: their side has an arm of flesh, ours has God.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: How doth the city sit _____, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!
verse: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!
note: Lamentations opens with a gasp: how doth the city sit 'solitary' — once full of people, now like a widow.
